page_title: NAN 1-2 REI | Nantes v Reims 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.

90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Keito Nakamura (Reims) and Junya Ito gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 1:2.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The game is interrupted. Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
86' Today's match ends for Douglas Augusto who will be replaced by Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes).
86' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Oumar Diakite and he is replaced by Amine Salama (Reims).
85' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
83' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alban Lafont intercepts the ball.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) will replace Matthis Abline.
80' Here is a change. Johann Lepenant is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes).
78' Keito Nakamura (Reims) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
76' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) tries to find Johann Lepenant, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Keito Nakamura (Reims) coming on for Yaya-Kader Fofana.
72' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Tino Kadewere will be replaced by Sorba Thomas (Nantes).
72' Substitution. Jean-Kevin Duverne is replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marshall Munetsi (Reims) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Junya Ito (Reims) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

68' Oumar Diakite (Reims) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Alban Lafont was alert and made an amazing save! The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
63' The substitution has been made. Reda Khadra (Reims) has replaced Teddy Teuma.

57' Oumar Diakite (Reims) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt. Reims will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

56' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Yehvann Diouf to get hold of the ball.
54' Nantes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
51' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
50' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
46' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) and blew his whistle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Moses Simon (Nantes) steps up to send the ball in.

45+4' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Buta (Reims) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45+1' Moses Simon (Nantes) will deliver the corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.
40' A crossfield pass from Buta (Reims) fails to find any of his teammates.
39' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Yehvann Diouf easily makes the save.

34' 1 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Nhoa Sangui showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the left post – 1:1.
33' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
32' Buta (Reims) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Reims get a corner.

31' Matthis Abline (Nantes) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
28' 1 - 0 Goal! Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is teed up on the edge of the box by Moses Simon, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:0.
26' Nantes take a short corner kick.

26' Great save! Matthis Abline (Nantes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Yehvann Diouf. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Teddy Teuma (Reims) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul.
18' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' Moses Simon (Nantes) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
13' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is penalised for holding. Willy Delajod signals a set piece. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Reims.
12' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee.
9' Moses Simon (Nantes) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
6' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Matthis Abline (Nantes) sends a wild header high over the bar.
6' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.

5' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Willy Delajod got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
